messages:
maria: Heads-up — spike on scoped API tokens / service accounts in the console. Product wants: per-route scopes, time-limited tokens, an "effective permissions" preview, and auditability. Want quick opinions before I wire a mockup.

kevin: +1 on preview. UX question: do we model this as (role + overrides) or as a flat scope list? I'd prefer role + explicit route overrides to reduce repetition.

ellie: If tenants can create route-scoped tokens we must ensure quotas/usage attribution is per-token. Do we currently tag telemetry with token id?

ravi: We emit principal_kind and principal_id on requests but not a scope blob. We can add scope metadata to the request events (e.g., scope_hash / scope_preview_v1). That will let dashboards attribute cost to tokens.

maria: Example token manifest I'm thinking of (for backend/telemetry alignment):

```
{
  "name": "billing-ingest",
  "type": "service_account",
  "roles": ["ingest.writer"],
  "scopes": [
    { "route": "/v1/embeddings", "methods": ["POST"] },
    { "model": "gpt-large", "max_tokens": 1000 }
  ],
  "expires_at": "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

kevin: Nice. For the console UX: two-column modal — left: Roles (base role picker) + Scopes (route/model/time). Right: Effective permissions preview + sample request simulator. Add an explicit "deny unless matched" toggle so admins can require matching scopes.

ellie: Migration: current tokens are tenant-scoped. We'll need a backend migration and a fallback behavior for old tokens (treat as full-tenant scopes). Also need enforcement for per-token quotas in the router.

ravi: Backend rules: validation at creation time; runtime enforcement in the auth layer. If a token's scope is malformed -> refuse creation. At runtime, if no scope matches, default DENY unless the token has an explicit "allow_all_fallback": true flag. I prefer explicit denial to avoid surprises.

maria: @ravi can you add telemetry events: `permission_grant` (when token issued) and attach `scope_hash` + a human readable `scope_preview_v1`? That'll help us build the Console audit view.

ravi: Yep. I'll add `permission_grant` + `scope_preview_v1` and emit `ui_action` when created from the console (so we can measure adoption).

product-lead: Rollout plan proposal: 
1) Feature-flag preview (UI read-only) + audit events for a week.
2) Behind FF: full create/edit flows but tenant-admins only.
3) Gradual enable for self-serve tenants.
4) Enterprise: expose policy templates + ability to enforce `deny_unscoped_tokens`.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag `scoped_tokens` toggled ON for canary. :rocket:

kevin: Don't forget copy/affordances: show revocation + quota impact up front. Also add a small inline help snippet linking to "how token scopes affect billing".

ellie: We should also add a telemetry dashboard: top tokens by token-scoped quota burn, and alerts when a single token exceeds X% of tenant usage.

maria: Agreed. I'll draft mocks and a short requirements doc (fields + validation + telemetry). Sync tomorrow 10:00am? :calendar:

kevin: Works for me.

ravi: I'll be there and will bring a list of telemetry event names + schema.

maria: Thanks — I'll drop the mock in #design after the sync.

ops-bot: note: canary deployment completed (scoped_tokens = on)
